title: Fix City Lod Vector Tile Quadrant Edges
description: At city LOD, vector tiles show visible quadrant/tile edges. Enable land backdrop fill at city and finer LOD bands to hide tile seams.
summary: City and finer vector-tile LOD bands (city, district, street, building) now enable `draw_land_backdrop` so each tile is filled with `land_fill` before landcover polygons are drawn. This hides visible tile-quadrant seams that appeared when only sparse landcover geometry was painted over the canvas clear color. Added `city_lod_fills_tile_backdrop_to_hide_seams` regression test; `cargo test -p gis_map city_lod` passes.
